original_value: A fictional 27-inch creative monitor designed for illustration, photo editing, and casual streaming. It features a wide-color IPS panel, 2560x1440 resolution, 100 Hz refresh rate, and USB-C input for laptop connectivity. The stand supports tilt and height adjustment, and the display includes built-in dual speakers and low-blue-light modes.
